title: Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill: A Model-Free Controller and Its Generalization Limits
abstract: arXiv:2609.38386v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Concurrent autoregressive inference creates a fundamental interference problem: prefilling a newly arrived long prompt can delay tokens for requests that are already decoding. Fixed prefill chunks reduce this interference, but the best chunk size depends on the model, hardware, load, and latency objective. We introduce Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill (DLFP), a model-free controller that changes only prefill work that overlaps active decodes. After a guarded scheduling cycle, DLFP uses the observed interval as proportional feedback to resize the next prefill chunk; isolated prefills remain unrestricted.   We implement DLFP in vLLM and evaluate it with open-loop Poisson arrivals, exact token accounting, raw request traces, and NVIDIA telemetry. translated_title: 解码延迟反馈预填充：一种无模型控制器及其泛化极限
translated_abstract: 并发自回归推理产生了一个根本性的干扰问题：为新到达的长提示词进行预填充，可能会延迟已在解码中的请求的token生成。固定的预填充块可以减少这种干扰，但最佳块大小取决于模型、硬件、负载和延迟目标。我们提出了解码延迟反馈预填充（DLFP），这是一种无模型控制器，它仅调整与活跃解码重叠的预填充工作。在一个受保护的调度周期之后，DLFP将观测到的解码间隔作为比例反馈来调整下一个预填充块的大小；而独立进行的预填充则保持不受限制。我们在vLLM中实现了DLFP，并通过开环泊松到达过程、精确的token计量、原始请求追踪和NVIDIA遥测数据对其进行评估。在一块A100 80GB GPU上以BF16精度运行Qwen3-0.6B的实验中，三次配对的100请求试验分别将P99 token间延迟降低了24.8%、30.1%和28.2%（平均27.7%，配对95%置信区间为21.0%至34.3%）……
tldr: DLFP是一种无模型控制器，它利用观测到的解码延迟作为比例反馈动态调整预填充块大小，从而减少预填充对正在解码请求的干扰，将P99 token间延迟平均降低27.7%。
en_tdlr: DLFP is a model-free controller that uses observed decode latency as proportional feedback to dynamically resize prefill chunks, mitigating interference with active decodes and reducing P99 inter-token latency by an average of 27.7%.
